name: screenshot
description: Captures a screenshot of the virtual desktop, target window, or Picture-in-Picture sandbox desktop. Supports Set-of-Marks (SOM) overlays (som=True), cluster density zoom (cluster_zoom=True), heuristic icon detection (detect_icons=True), differential dirty-rect crops (mode='delta'), and isolated sandbox preview (mode='pip').

cluster_zoom.description: When true in SOM mode, automatically zooms into the densest cluster of controls (e.g. ribbon/toolbar) for high-precision targeting.

detect_icons.description: When true in SOM mode, runs local heuristic icon detection to ground buttons in non-UIA GPU-rendered apps.

max_dim.description: Maximum dimension for image downsampling (default 1024 keeps image tokens at ~250 tokens).

mode.description: Capture mode: 'full' captures the full view, 'delta' transmits changed bounding box, and 'pip' captures the Picture-in-Picture sandbox preview.

som.description: When true, overlays numbered Set-of-Marks (SOM) badges on interactive elements for direct integer clicking.

target.description: Optional window title substring to capture only that window (e.g. 'Notepad'). Default captures full desktop.
